MID-CYCLE MANUAL RUN: judgment written 2026-08-26, five calendar days after the 2026-08-21 close this file reads. Two of the five sessions in the week window (Mon 08-24, Tue 08-25) had already traded. The three catalysts that dominate the window -- July core PCE and NVDA earnings (both 08-26), and the Warsh Jackson Hole keynote (08-28) -- were all still ahead, and the pinned research snapshot (2026-08-24) carries no post-08-21 outcomes. The week horizon is still not a clean ex-ante forecast and must not be graded as one.

why: Financials run +38.0 pct absolute and +6.7 pts excess in archetype 1, second only to Technology among expansion leaders (The Full Regime-Sector Matrix).

This is the one sector the atypical rate backdrop helps mechanically: banks expanded median NIM to 3.38 pct from 3.27 pct in the 2022 cycle with more than 65 pct reporting higher NIM, and SSGA places Banks in Tier 1 positive responders to the 10Y (R2 0.228) (Sector Macro Sensitivity Matrix).
risks: Credit stress is migrating rather than disappearing: KRE underperformed KBE by 180 bps on the week and loan-loss provisions are rising at the regionals while money-center banks still guide to stable credit. A break below $48 on XLF forces a re-evaluation of the whole sector thesis (wiki/synthesis.md@cd85b433).

why: Panel has Financials +4.11 pts vs SPY on the month and rank 2 of 11 on the week, so the arithmetic and the archetype-1 prior point the same way (panel metrics, this file; The Full Regime-Sector Matrix).

The curve shape is the driver, not the level: SSGA measures Banks at +1.85 pct average monthly relative return in bear-steepening regimes versus -1.91 pct in bull-flattening, and the 8/21 week was a bear move with the 10Y at a 52-week-high close (Sector Macro Sensitivity Matrix; wiki/economic-calendar.md@63b4d3ba).
risks: Financials are rated double-negative in recession and post the worst excess return of any sector in any archetype during a systemic credit crisis (-15.7 pts). The NIM tailwind does not survive a credit event (The Full Regime-Sector Matrix; Sector Macro Sensitivity Matrix).
The curve remains historically flat despite the steepening; book value at ~1.1x is cheap but not a catalyst (wiki/synthesis.md@cd85b433).

extracts.lead_summary: Financials are the bond market's shadow. When the yield curve speaks, the banks listen.
